title: S8 Classification System and Code-Set Fields

entries.name: System ID
entries.description: Stable governed identifier for the classification system.

entries.name: Scope / Domain
entries.description: The information domain to which the system applies, such as elements, spaces, activities, assets, or project-specific categories.

entries.name: Origin / Standard Reference
entries.description: Traceable external, client, industry, or internal origin for the classification system.

entries.name: Governance Owner / Steward
entries.description: Governed role or team responsible for maintaining the system entry.

entries.name: Version
entries.description: Version or edition of the governed classification system or code set.

entries.name: Status
entries.description: Governed lifecycle status such as proposed, approved, deprecated, or superseded.

entries.name: Code-Set ID
entries.description: Stable identifier for a governed collection of classification codes within the system.

entries.name: Applicable Project / Portfolio Scope
entries.description: Declared project, portfolio, discipline, or information-use scope for the code set.

entries.name: Allowed Levels / Facets
entries.description: Permitted table, group, facet, level, or equivalent subdivision where relevant.

entries.name: Usage Guidance
entries.description: Additional governed usage constraints without duplicating the underlying external code list.

entries.name: Effective From
entries.description: Date, version, or project condition from which the classification entry applies.

governance_notes: This registry defines the required governance fields for classification systems and code sets; it does not itself adopt Uniclass, OmniClass, MasterFormat, CCI, or any other named system as an enterprise default.
Actual classification code lists remain separate governed machine-readable artifacts or external authoritative references.
Project-specific classification selection must be driven by S2 information requirements, client requirements, and governed project declarations.

provenance.migration_note: GAP-S8-02 system/code-set governance fields migrated without promoting any example classification system as mandatory.
